versions.summary: Disk-crash root cause fixed (Remotion bundles no longer copy the 9 GB asset library: 9 GB to 0.3 GB per render), four-layer disk failsafe with live watchdog and automatic compaction, internet failsafe, comment auto-replies with guardrails, topic research, version history on GitHub and the landing page

Security and operations: secret scanning on every commit and site publish, digest-pinned Docker images, owner-only credential files, token health on the dashboard, upload audit log, SECURITY.md, encrypted off-machine backups, daily maintenance with Windows alerts, disk-use trends and forecast, landing-page Status tab, weekly digest

Disk failsafe after the Nov 17-18 WSL disk-full incident: disk check on every heavy stage (C: free, vhdx compaction gap, WSL I/O health), channel-agnostic cleanup of regenerable data only, compaction and backup scripts, dashboard Disk panel, Security tab on the landing page, incident report

Tiny Streak joins: film mode for wordless short films (gibberish voices, sound effects, film score, Pip and the Glim, lived-in sets, film QA), new felt-piano jingles on every channel, feelings for both channels' characters, smoother eased motion, channel setup guide with permanent Google sign-ins, nightly public production for all three channels

Framework release: checkpointed pipeline, approval gates, per-scene rendering, post-render QA, Shorts pipeline (clip finder, standalone rule, 9:16 render), multi-channel support (channels/ registry, youtube.py --channel), reference-analysis tools and channel style tests; framework-first README and architecture docs

Checkpointed pipeline with approval gates and contact sheets, post-render QA on every render, per-scene rendering + stitch, word-level caption component, dashboard GUI (Ready for you, analytics, retention, comments, calendar, readiness, chat), three 15-minute videos, new docs and landing page
Route A v2 (centred layout, fit-to-box text, backdrops, outlined characters, crossfades) + Route B v2 captions; automatic layout check; repo library; dashboard
